en:
The culprit used the sloped roof as a
<CLT=cltSTRONG>slide<CLT=cltNORMAL> for Miu's avatar!

Nah, man. Even with the slope and the 
snow, Miu's body wouldn't have slid—

But the avatars can generate friction. We
wouldn't have been able to walk, otherwise.

So I doubt that it would have had
*that* much momentum.
It wouldn't slide! Just like Maki Roll said!
It would slide! Just like Shumai said!

Oh! He's a pupil of Ramenman!
Erm, sorry... My hobbies slipped in...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm positive that that's how
Miu's avatar was moved. But...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe the culprit used something
else as well to help her body slide.
